verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime original-Arabic novel publication span from Khufu’s Wisdom to The Coffeehouse; it is a selected publishing proxy, not a complete bibliography or claim of uninterrupted work.
verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Markers use first Arabic publication, except that Children of Gebelawi is explicitly marked by the beginning of its 1959 Al-Ahram serialization. They do not use composition dates, later book editions or English translations. Midaq Alley and Palace Walk reached English long after their Arabic debuts; Children of Gebelawi’s serial appearance preceded a Beirut book edition and its long Egyptian publication ban. Short stories, plays, screenplays, columns, autobiography and posthumous translations are excluded.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
